maria (eng-runtime): Heads up — around 01:12 UTC we saw a sudden 95th/99th latency spike on prod-serving (p50 steady). Grafana shows throughput dip concurrently. Looks like a cluster-level event, but traces are missing for a subset of requests. Anyone oncall?
kenji (eng-sre): I'm oncall. Which dashboards are you looking at? Any correlation with kernel selection or batching?
maria (eng-runtime): Route: /v1/generate -> model-redwood-7b. p99 jumped from ~120ms to ~1.2s for ~6m. Kernel selector shows a flurry of kernel change events but traces for ~40% of those high-latency requests are absent. KV cache eviction rate spiked too.
anjali (eng-runtime): Uploading tiny snippet of the runtime logs I grabbed:
```
[01:12:08] scheduler: batch_id=8943 size=1 kernel=fp16_opt -> switched kernel=fp16_alt
[01:12:09] kvcache: eviction_rate=0.87 threshold=0.2
[01:12:09] trace-sampler: sampled=0/123 policy=legacy
[01:12:09] runtime: request-id=aa11 dropped-trace-metadata=missing
```
maria (eng-runtime): That trace-sampler line is worrying — seems like the sampler returned 0 samples for a lot of requests. Can someone confirm sampling config?
kenji (eng-sre): Checking trace-sampler service — last deploy at 00:50 changed the default sampling rate param from 0.05 -> 0.0 due to an opt-in flag bug. Reverting now. Might explain missing traces. Rolling back to 00:50 build id.
tyler (eng-platform): We also had an infra reclaim job that fired at 01:10 which triggered noisy-tenant throttles on the GPU pool. It reclaimed ephemeral GPUs from a batch tenant with a high kernel-switch churn. That could explain kernel mis-picks and KV thrashing.
anjali (eng-runtime): If noisy tenant was preempted, their KV cache entries would be evicted aggressively, causing a hit to latencies for colocated actors. I can collect per-tenant eviction histograms and kernel-switch counts for that window.
kenji (eng-sre): Rollback done for trace-sampler, now sampling at expected 5%. OpsBot: runbook-incident-collector collect --window 01:05-01:20 --tags kernel,kvcache,trace-sampler
OpsBot: runbook-incident-collector started (job id 20260318-77). Collecting logs, pprof, and sched snapshots.
maria (eng-runtime): I triggered debug-level runtime sampling for that model route (5m) and enabled kvcache debug counters. Adding a temporary rule to prefer the stable fp16_opt kernel for pinned routes to reduce mis-selection while we investigate.
tyler (eng-platform): Noted. I'll also temporarily pin the noisy tenant to a different pool and increase soft eviction thresholds on shared pools until we finish root cause.
anjali (eng-runtime): Early profile: pprof heap shows spike in per-request allocations during the window, but kernel switch churn increases lock contention on allocator path. Suspect kernel selection fallback path is more allocation-heavy.
kenji (eng-sre): Good find. Actionable items: 1) eng-runtime to analyze kernel selector heuristics and add telemetry for mis-selection reason codes (owner: anjali). 2) eng-platform to add tenant isolation guard to prevent reclaim while serving (owner: tyler). 3) eng-sre to reconcile trace sampling config and surface a deployment test for sampler flags (owner: kenji). 4) eng-runtime to run regression test for KV eviction behavior under a noisy tenant replay (owner: maria).
maria (eng-runtime): I'll open PRs and a short postmortem once we have artifacts from OpsBot. Tentative RCA: combined regression — trace-sampler misconfig hid trace evidence and a concurrent reclaim caused noisy-tenant eviction -> kernel fallback-> allocator contention -> p99 spike.
anjali (eng-runtime): One more note: dashboards don't show kernel-switch counts by default (observability gap). We should add a per-route kernel-switch metric and make our SLO dashboards surface it as an annotation. Filing a dashboard request now.
tyler (eng-platform): I'll also add an alert for kvcache eviction_rate > 0.4 sustained for 1m.
kenji (eng-sre): Thanks team. OpsBot: once collection completes, upload artifacts to #incidents and mark the runbook step completed.
OpsBot: runbook-incident-collector completed (job id 20260318-77). Artifacts: logs.tar.gz, pprof.tgz, scheduler_snap.json uploaded to https://artifacts/internal/20260318-77
maria (eng-runtime): Got artifacts. I'll prioritize kernel-selector unit tests and a small perf micro-bench to reproduce allocator contention. Will update thread with PR links. :thumbsup:
kenji (eng-sre): Closing immediate on-call loop — monitoring for recurrence. If p99 stays below 200ms for 1h with no eviction alarms, we'll mark incident resolved.
